en: Angel, the incident has vanished.{wait}{clear}＜イベント名＞ in ＜地方名＞ seems to have gone away.{wait}{clear}＜勇者名＞-sama, who was on the way there, didn't make it in time.
＜勇者名＞-sama has arrived at ＜目的地名＞.
A report, Angel.{wait}{clear}I searched ＜地方名＞, but found nothing unusual.
A report, Angel.{wait}{clear}Your level seems about to rise. When you return to the Heavens, I think you should go see Raphael-sama.
Angel, it's terrible! ＜勇者名＞-sama has lost their life in battle with an enemy bewitched by a fallen angel...{wait}{clear}It's terribly sad, but ＜勇者名＞-sama's soul can never be recovered.
Angel, I've found a hero candidate, so I've come to report.

In Sayak, Celesta, in the Six Kingdoms Alliance, I found a young Warlock.{wait}{clear}His name is Fein Lu Lugus. He seems to do all kinds of work on commission from the Guild of mages.{wait}{clear}He's also very knowledgeable, and seems well versed in the history of Arcaya. Why not go and meet him?

In Leszno, Slatina, in the Duchy of Courrege, I found a young vampire hunter.{wait}{clear}His name is Clive Saingrent. He seems to hunt undead on commission from towns and villages.{wait}{clear}There's something shadowy about him that worries me a little, but I think his skill is real.{wait}{clear}Why not go and meet him right away?

I found a hero candidate in Fanlan, the capital of the Kingdom of Legrance, in Ellora.{wait}{clear}His name is Rudiere Trier Legrance. He's the second prince of Legrance, but he seems to have almost nothing to do with affairs of state.{wait}{clear}He always seems to be off playing, but his curiosity and drive are stronger than anyone's.{wait}{clear}So I'm sure he'll be a help to you, Angel. Why not go and meet him once?

In Araras, the capital of the Holy Nation of Ecclesia, in Linares, I found a young man worthy of being a hero candidate.{wait}{clear}He's a young clergyman named Rocus Las Flores.{wait}{clear}I heard a rumor that he's to become Pope, but I couldn't find out if it's true. But he certainly has a special power.{wait}{clear}Since he's a clergyman, perhaps he'll be easy for you to talk to, Angel? Please do go and meet him.

In Darg on Bremes Isle, I found a girl who's a mage.{wait}{clear}Her name is Irene Tirnag. She lives all alone in a tower and devotes every day to the pursuit of magical knowledge.{wait}{clear}I sense very strong magical power in her, so I'm sure she'll do great things as a hero.{wait}{clear}Why not go and meet her, Angel?

In Reizefut, capital of the Grosain Empire, in the province of Reizefut, I found a woman who's an Imperial knight.{wait}{clear}Her name is Leyla Vigrid. They say she's the first woman ever to become a knight, so she must have superb swordsmanship and a strong spirit.{wait}{clear}I couldn't learn the details, but she seems to be held prisoner now.{wait}{clear}I sense she's full of justice, and I don't think she's a bad person.{wait}{clear}So won't you help her? Please, Angel.

In Leiria, Fes, in the untamed lands, I found a girl who's very skilled with a bow.{wait}{clear}Her name is Cecia. She's a daughter of the clan that lives in the Reyforia Forest, which covers the untamed lands.{wait}{clear}She seems very pure and has a strong sense of justice, so I'm sure she'll help you, Angel. Why not go and meet her?
Angel, Fein Lu Lugus, whom we found as a hero candidate, has died.{wait}{clear}He seems to have been attacked by someone on his travels... It's a great shame, but one of Arcaya's hopes has been lost.

Angel, Fein Lu Lugus-sama, whom we found as a hero candidate, has gone missing.{wait}{clear}It seems to be because the Empire attacked the Guild, but we have no idea where Fein-sama is...{wait}{clear}It's a great shame, but one of Arcaya's hopes has been lost.

Angel, Rudiere Trier Legrance-sama, whom we found as a hero candidate, has gone missing.{wait}{clear}I think it's because his brother the king was assassinated by someone... We have no idea where Rudiere-sama is...{wait}{clear}It's a great shame, but one of Arcaya's hopes has been lost.

We have no idea where Rocus-sama is...{wait}{clear}It's a great shame, but one of Arcaya's hopes has been lost.

Angel, Irene Tirnag-sama, whom we found as a hero candidate, has gone missing.{wait}{clear}It seems to have something to do with the revival of the Heavenly Dragon... We have no idea where Irene-sama is...{wait}{clear}It's a great shame, but one of Arcaya's hopes has been lost.

Angel, Leyla Vigrid-sama, whom we found as a hero candidate, has died.{wait}{clear}She had long been held prisoner by the Empire, and she was killed still bearing a false charge...{wait}{clear}It's terribly sad, but one of Arcaya's hopes has been lost.

Angel, Leyla Vigrid-sama, whom we found as a hero candidate, has gone missing.{wait}{clear}It seems to be because her mother in Reizefut, the Imperial capital, has died... We have no idea where Leyla-sama is...{wait}{clear}It's a great shame, but one of Arcaya's hopes has been lost.

Angel, Cecia-sama, whom we found as a hero candidate, has gone missing.{wait}{clear}It seems to be because the Holy Mother of the Reyforia Forest has died... We have no idea where Cecia-san is...{wait}{clear}It's a great shame, but one of Arcaya's hopes has been lost.
Angel, the Empire's invasion has begun in earnest.{wait}{clear}I think it will affect many countries and regions of the world. Please keep a close eye on changes in the chaos level.

Angel! The Empire has begun invading toward the heart of the Six Kingdoms.{wait}{clear}Besides the Six Kingdoms, the frontier and other countries bordering the Empire are being invaded one after another.{wait}{clear}Please be careful, both the heroes and you, Angel.

Angel! The Empire has finally invaded even the untamed lands.{wait}{clear}If this momentum continues, there's no telling how far the Empire will spread its territory.{wait}{clear}Please ask the heroes to keep the damage down somehow.

Angel! The Empire invaded Alkmaar in Basel and destroyed the Grand Lodge, the heart of the Guild.{wait}{clear}I think this will have a very serious effect on every country.{wait}{clear}It also seems something very important has fallen into the Empire's hands.{wait}{clear}Stopping the Empire's invasion may be hard even for the heroes, but please be careful the chaos level doesn't rise.

Angel! Diana-sama, the Holy Mother of the Reyforia Forest, was attacked by a boy with a beast.{wait}{clear}And it seems Cecia-sama, who is also your hero, will inherit her will and become the Holy Mother.

Angel... The heroes fought hard, but... the capital of the Holy Nation of Ecclesia has fallen to the Empire.{wait}{clear}The city was badly destroyed, and the cathedral went up in flames...{wait}{clear}Many people died, but it seems some escaped.{wait}{clear}Angel... what on earth will become of Arcaya? Please be careful too, Angel.
Angel...! The king of the Kingdom of Legrance, Hugues Zeint, has died.{wait}{clear}This is only a rumor, but they say he was assassinated by someone...

Angel! The Empire has invaded even Legrance.{wait}{clear}And there seem to be demons in the Imperial Army, so the Demon Stone's power must be in use.{wait}{clear}I know the fighting is hard, but please do your best, Angel. I'll do my best too.
Angel! The boy named Ion, who stole the Demon Stone from the Forest of the Holy Mother, has died.{wait}{clear}It seems the Empire's witch Serenis was using the strong magical power he had.
Angel! Savio, leader of the assassins of Legrance, has died.{wait}{clear}It seems the Empire's witch Serenis was using his hatred of the nobility.

Angel!! The Heavenly Dragon has finally been revived.{wait}{clear}The Heavenly Dragon, incarnation of Satan's soul, will swallow town after town and person after person...{wait}{clear}The world's collapse is only a matter of time. Angel, please join forces with the heroes and protect Arcaya.

Angel! A hero has defeated Clarence, the "Viper" who stole the Demon Stone from the Holy Nation of Ecclesia.{wait}{clear}It seems he had no hope for this world, and sided with the Empire of his own accord...
